subject: Testlet model with direct effect on manifest variables

messages.author: 177d6b42224d530a
messages.subject: Testlet model with direct effect on manifest variables
parts:
Hello Dr. Chalmers,

I would like to run a testlet or second order model with direct effect on manifest variables as in the figure enclosed from:

Chen, F. F., West, S. G., & Sousa, K. H. (2006). A comparison of bifactor and
second-order models of quality of life. Multivariate Behavioral Research, 41,
189–225.

The same model is also in :
Yung, Y. F., Thissen, D., & McLeod, L. D. (1999). On the relationship between the higher-order factor model and the hierarchical factor model. Psychometrika, 64, 113–128.

I know how to run It on Mplus but  not on MIRT package. 

More precisely I don't how to change in my syntax below to get the wanted model.

Could you please help me ?

Many thanks in advance of your reply.

Pierre-Charles Soulié


ddd=read.table("CH.csv",sep=";")
dim(ddd)

spec<-'

G = 1-15

F1 = 1,2,3,4,5
F2 = 6,7,8
F3 = 9,10,11
F4 = 12,13,14,15

CONSTRAIN = (1, a1,a2), (2, a1,a2), (3, a1,a2), (4,a1,a2), (5,a1,a2),
CONSTRAIN = (6,a1,a3), (7,a1,a3), (8,a1,a3)
CONSTRAIN = (9,a1,a4), (10,a1,a4), (11,a1,a4)
CONSTRAIN = (12,a1,a5), (13,a1,a5),(14,a1,a5),(15,a1,a5)
FREE = (GROUP, COV_22),(GROUP, COV_33),(GROUP, COV_44),(GROUP, COV_55)'

mod.md<- mirt(ddd, model=spec, itemtype="graded", SE = TRUE)
mod.md
extract.mirt(mod.md, what="time")
coef(mod.md, simplify=TRUE)
coef(mod.md, printSE=TRUE)
fscores(mod.md, method="EAP", full.scores=FALSE, full.scores.SE = FALSE)

ddd=read.table("CH.csv",sep=";")
dim(ddd)

spec1<-c(rep(1,5),rep(2,3),rep(3,3),rep(4,4))
spec2<-'G = 1-15

CONSTRAIN = (1, a1,a2), (2, a1,a2), (3, a1,a2), (4,a1,a2), (5,a1,a2),
CONSTRAIN = (6,a1,a3), (7,a1,a3), (8,a1,a3)
CONSTRAIN = (9,a1,a4), (10,a1,a4), (11,a1,a4)
CONSTRAIN = (12,a1,a5), (13,a1,a5),(14,a1,a5),(15,a1,a5)
FREE = (GROUP, COV_22),(GROUP, COV_33),(GROUP, COV_44),(GROUP, COV_55)'

mod.md<-bfactor(ddd, model=spec1, model2 = spec2, SE=TRUE)
mod.md
extract.mirt(mod.md, what='time')
coef(mod.md, simplify=TRUE)
coef(mod.md, printSE=TRUE)
fscores(mod.md, method='EAP', full.scores=FALSE, full.scores.SE = FALSE)

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Testlet model with direct effect on manifest variables
parts:
The model presented in your attached image is equivalent to the bifactor model, so you may as well use the standard bifactor() function to fit this effect sans the direct effects on the specific factors. 

Phil
